donuts.name: Chocolate Dip
donuts.description: Classic ring donut dipped in melted chocolate.
donuts.standards: Even dark chocolate glaze covering entire top surface. Ring shape intact. No gaps or drips. Glossy finish. No pale patches.

donuts.name: Maple Dip
donuts.description: Classic ring donut dipped in maple sauce.
donuts.standards: Golden maple fondant evenly applied. Clean ring shape. No cracking. Uniform amber colour. No pale or over-dark patches.

donuts.name: Vanilla Dip
donuts.description: Classic ring dipped in vanilla with colourful sprinkles.
donuts.standards: White vanilla fondant evenly applied. Colourful sprinkles uniformly distributed. Ring shape intact. Sprinkles not clumped.

donuts.name: Maple & Salted Caramel
donuts.description: Donut dipped in maple fondant, filled with caramel, topped with caramel fudge.
donuts.standards: Maple fondant base evenly applied. Caramel fudge topping clearly visible. Generous caramel drizzle. No dry or cracked surface.

donuts.name: Boston Cream
donuts.description: Donut filled with Venetian cream and dipped in chocolate fondant.
donuts.standards: Smooth chocolate fondant top. Round filled shape. Even chocolate coverage. No collapsed shape. No visible holes.

donuts.name: Blueberry Filled
donuts.description: Donut filled with blueberry puree, dipped in white chocolate, blueberry drizzle.
donuts.standards: White chocolate coating clean and even. Blueberry drizzle visible on top. Round filled shape. No pale or uncoated patches.

donuts.name: Blueberry Cheesecake
donuts.description: Donut filled with cheesecake, dipped in vanilla fondant, blueberry sauce drizzle.
donuts.standards: Vanilla fondant base smooth and even. Blueberry sauce drizzle clearly visible. Generous filling. Premium appearance. No dry cracks.
